correctness.rationale: Integration of the base Laplace profile gives I_n=a(1−(−1)^n exp(−πa))/(π(a²+n²))>0. Write A=1−(−1)^n exp(−πa) and x=(a²+n²)^{-1}. Independently differentiating axA twice and forming I_n−a I_n′+(a²/3)I_n″ gives the ratio (a² A″−a A′)/(3A)−4a³ A′ x/(3A)+8a⁴ x²/3. It is positive at odd n; n=0 is positive by integration. At nonzero even n the sharp constraint is exactly b≥L+cx_m−hx_m². The coefficient series is absolutely summable, so no infinite Fourier sign issue is lost. The expression is L+hx_*²−h(x_m−x_*)², and since x_m↓0, some 0<x_m<2x_* gives a value above L. The lattice maximum is attained at one or both bracketing indices, or at 1 if the continuous optimum lies below that index. The adjacent difference has the sign of R_m−1 for R_m=2x_*/(x_m+x_{m+1}). The log derivative of x_* is <−2/a, whereas that of x_m+x_{m+1} is >−2/a. Thus R_m decreases from ∞ to 0 in a and increases in m for fixed a. The resulting ordered adjacent crossings are unbounded since R_m→∞ at each fixed a; the signs before and after each crossing prove the asserted set of maximizers without skips. At threshold, consecutive large frequencies give a Vandermonde system forcing any null Gram weights to vanish. The missing characters obstruct uniform RKHS density; above threshold every character belongs to the RKHS. The real bracketing index is (4aQ/π−a²)^{1/2}/2 and is asymptotic to √(a/π) exp(πa/2); x_m has mesh O((aQ)^{-3/2}) there. Multiplying the squared mesh error by h=O(a⁴) gives O(aQ^{-3}), with continuous gain π²a²/(6Q²). At small a the first mode is active and the O(a²) correction to L leaves the stated linear term unchanged.

value.rationale: This is a natural feasibility problem for the least rough component that repairs a standard but inadmissible covariance within a fixed matched-scale family. The high-frequency necessary bound is strictly insufficient for every a; the obstruction is a moving finite notch with no skipped even index and an exponential index law. Strict finite-site PD versus failure of universality at equality is a meaningful boundary consequence.
